name: A3400
description: "Vacuum tube type control amplifier kit.The equalizer circuit uses the K-K Ï‰ NF type, which is close to the Marantz type, and was newly developed after ascertaining the characteristics of the Marantz Model7 and Macintosh C-22 circuits. In this A3400 circuit, the cathode resistance of the third stage is divided into 33k � and 3.3k � to prevent the amount of NF in the ultra-high band from becoming unnecessarily large. In addition, by locally applying NF from the third stage cathode to the first stage plate, the bare characteristics before the major NF is applied are improved, and the strain rate characteristics are improved.The intermediate amplifier is a 3-pole tube 2-stage configuration. In order to suppress the gain of the A3400 and not to worsen the distortion at high output, we have adopted a B-type balancer (insertion loss is approximately -8dB) to provide an appropriate overall gain. This is because in order to achieve a low gain at the 2-stage configuration, the high feedback type inevitably reduces the negative feedback resistance, so this resistance becomes the second stage plate load and prevents the distortion at high output from worsening.By installing a linear equalizer in this stage and switching the feedback element, frequency characteristics with a linear slope can be obtained over the whole band.The tone control circuit uses the Lux-NF type.Since a print switch is used for adjusting the low and high sound levels, flat characteristics are improved and stable control is possible.This circuit is also capable of defeat.The output circuit uses a cathode follower to keep the output impedance low.This stage is equipped with a filter that can switch the cut-off frequency in two stages for both high and low frequencies. This is an NF type filter using a cathode follower, and it is a genuine filter that cuts at a slope of -12dB per octave."

The structure emphasizes the reproducibility of pulse components (impulse response) beyond the reproducibility of continuous sine waves.The F Ï‰ E Ï‰ DAC is fundamentally different from the conventional D/A converter in which the digital code is converted into a step-like form before analog conversion. The digital code is directly connected by a curve using a new interpolation function for analog reproduction. This realizes an extremely natural waveform natural waveform and approaches the waveform of an analog signal of music. Moreover, the F Ï‰ E Ï‰ DAC has excellent impulse response and faithfully responds to instantaneous pulse input without generating excessive vibration. Therefore, ideal reproducibility of step response, which was impossible with analog disks and tape decks until now, is realized.The F Ï‰ E Ï‰ DAC is a waveform reproduction method in which digital codes are directly connected by a curve without changing them in a stepwise manner. Therefore, in principle, it eliminates the necessary evils such as digital filters that generate waveform vibration and analog filters that inevitably generate phase shifts.The analog circuit uses a pure A-class service machine that supplies a constant bias current up to the maximum output.The quality of DAC is fully utilized by the pure A-class system and low-impedance transmission analog circuit that LAX has consistently adopted.The input jacks are equipped with coaxial input Route 3 and optical input Route 3.Two high-speed standard type optical input terminals are installed, and the other one is equipped with an ultra-high-speed optical terminal unique to LUX with a transmission rate several tens of times higher than that of the conventional one.In addition, two digital output terminals (standard type optical and coaxial) are installed as digital outputs for recording.In addition to the canon connector for balanced outputs, the analog outputs are equipped with a total Route 3 output of one direct / variable coaxial outputs each.The chassis consists of two stages, and the analog and digital sections are completely separated. name: E-03
description: "Phono equalizer with independent configuration of MM/MC.In order to minimize the transmission distance to the analog player, a compact design has been adopted that allows grounding near the player.The E-03 employs a 4-amp configuration with independent amplifiers for MM/MC in addition to the left and right channels. It is compatible with all cartridges with impedance values around it, including the orthophone type with internal impedance of 2 � and the 40 � denon type.The MM amplifier consists of a differential amplifier circuit using two high-Gm dual FETs per channel in parallel for the first stage, a P-type low-noise dual transistor for the second stage, and a high-gain emitter-follower connection for the current amplifier stage.The MC amplifier circuit configuration consists of four High-Gm dual FETs per channel connected in parallel to the first stage differential circuit, receiving the differential by the next stage P-channel transistor, and combining a current mirror circuit to ensure high gain. The final stage emitter-follower circuit is a two stage Darlington connection with high current amplification.Both the MM and MC circuits use the same type of element for matching tone.It uses an NF-type equalizer that can simplify the circuit and is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The NF-type equalizer suffers from the problem of a high-pass rise in the corrected frequency response, but the E-03 solves this problem by determining the constant using computer simulation and realizes an extremely flat RIAA curve.In addition, the feedback circuit uses an AC/DC-separated feedback duo-beta circuit that is highly evaluated as an original circuit of Lux. In addition, the excellent RIAA deviation is realized by using a lot of high-precision, high-sound quality parts developed in Shinkai exclusively for E-03.In order to achieve pure signal transmission, the MM/MC equalizer is switched to the ground side at the output stage rather than at the input stage, so that the signal from the weak cartridge is input to the equalizer circuit without passing through the selector switch.In addition, the switch that selects the output signal to the amplifier short-circuits the input of the circuit side that is not selected by the relay, and the crosstalk performance is also examined. In addition, the short relay on the input prevents the adverse effect of the offset voltage on the cartridge when the power is turned on and realizes the demagnetization effect.The transformer used in the power supply unit is designed with strict measures against leakage flux from the design stage. The magnetic flux density is set at 9,000 gauss to suppress leakage flux generation itself. The core of the EI transformer is shielded with copper, and the transformer is placed in a double shield structure. The transformer is mounted in a mechanical floating mount system to prevent vibration.In addition, the secondary winding of the transformer consists of three windings that are independent of the Route 3 of the MM/MC / control circuit. After rectification, a regulator circuit is installed for each left and right channel to eliminate mutual interference between amplifiers and channels via the power supply.Non-interference construction is used for the internal construction. Each circuit is completely separated from the chassis center to prevent mutual interference. In addition, the signal amplifier circuit and the power supply circuit are separated by a shielding plate while being arranged at the shortest distance.In addition, an optimum constant voltage power supply is arranged independently for each of 4 amplifiers of L/R and MM/MC.A 2-core shielded cable is used for the signal cable to cut off noise that tends to mix in the transmission line.The E-03 has an all-discrete configuration for all circuits, including accessory circuits such as relay controls, eliminating the IC-specific coloring.Custom-made high-quality parts are used, and glass-epoxy circuit boards and polystyrene capacitors in copper cases are used."

name: LMC-1
description: "MC type cartridge with unique power generation and support system.The LMC (Linear Magneto-field Cross) power generation mechanism is adopted for the power generation system. The unique structure realizes ultra-lightweight, high-efficiency and linear power generation. With this system, the total weight of the power generation system is reduced to 1/8 of the conventional system, and the power generation efficiency is 5 times higher.In the LMC power generation system, two ring-shaped samarium-cobalt dual magnets aligned coaxially with the direction of the cantilever generate an ideal magnetic field that is uniform in all directions at 360 � around the cantilever without using a yoke. This allows the magnetic flux to be made perpendicular to the entire surface of the coil without loss, thus achieving both high efficiency and linearity.A 0.3 � sapphire rod is used for the cantilever to realize high fidelity transmission.Natural diamond is used for the material of the stylus, and by making it a semi-line contact type with excellent tracing capability, elastic deformation of the record is minimized and traceability up to high frequencies up to 60 kHz is realized.It adopts a concentrated mounting structure with a unique block chassis support structure.In conventional MC cartridges with low power generation efficiency, the power generation system is heavy. Therefore, the monocoque structure, which is supported by the case itself without having a chassis to fix the power generation system, was used in order to achieve low mass. However, if a lightweight resin case is used with this method, harmful resonance occurs and coloring occurs in the reproduced sound. The LMC power generation system has succeeded in making the power generation system extremely light. Therefore, it is possible to have sufficient weight and strong structure for the support part. To solve this problem, a block chassis is formed using vibration-proof metal with excellent damping characteristics, and the entire vibration system is fixed in the axial (cantilever) direction. All other parts are also directly connected to the block chassis to form a centralized mounting structure.This block chassis is the only structure that fixes the vibration system with this structure, and the cover is not related to the support structure to prevent the coloring of sound caused by deformation and squeal.The LMC-1 uses an anti-vibration zinc alloy SPZ machined block chassis for this part.In the vibration system, the vibrator point is made clear by stainless steel wire with excellent linearity, and the damper load, which is non-linear operation, is reduced by linearly absorbing the needle pressure load.The mounting surface of the shell and is mirror finished to prevent resonance."

description: "Line controller using a 23-step trans-type attenuator for level control.While general attenuators generally use the attenuation characteristics of resistors, the AT-3000 is equipped with a line signal transformer that is Shinkai generated for the attenuator in consideration of the influence of DC resistance components that enter the signal line in series on sound quality.By taking out 23 steps from the secondary winding of the transformer and switching each level with a high-precision rotary switch, resistors can be completely eliminated and direct current resistance is minimized.The TRANSFORMERS for the attenuator uses a multi-layered structure of 0.2 mm nickel super-permalloy based on numerous prototypes and listening tests. name: 5F70
description: "Tone control amplifier designed for the laboratory reference series.The 5F70 uses a newly developed DML-IC newly developed DML-IC at key points to provide perfect drift control without compromising the original sound quality.The basic configuration consists of a tone control circuit and an acoustic control circuit.The tone control circuit has a newly developed FET with low notching and high Gm (forward transfer admittance). Moreover, the differential amplifier circuit is composed of FET with well-balanced both units. The DC amplifier configuration is basically composed of FET with current mirror circuit, cascode circuit, constant current circuit, etc., and DC drift is prevented by effectively arranging DML-IC where DC gain exists.Both boost and cut tone control uses a CR-type circuit for both boost and cut. In the audible band, this power supply takes advantage of its characteristics and provides feedback from the low band to the DC range to enhance stability and braking force."

name: L-58A
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier with an original duo-beta circuit that not only improves the characteristics but also improves the quality of the amplifier to improve sound quality.Duo Beta Circuit means a circuit that combines two NFBs.This circuit does not attempt to improve various characteristics of the amplifier by investing a large amount of NFB. Instead, various characteristics are improved by creating an amplifier with good quality (bare characteristics) and combining it with a small amount of NFB and DC servo.In the power amplifier section, a pure complimentary service differential push-pull circuit using FETs for N-channel 2SK163 and P-channel (2SJ44) is adopted at the input stage to improve bare strain characteristics as a DC-amplifier configuration.In addition, everything from the input stage to the output stage is composed of a push-pull circuit, and at the same time, a transistor and FET with high ft (high cutoff frequency) and low Cob (collector output capacitance) are adopted to reduce distortion.The output stage employs MOS FETs (2SK134 and 2SJ49) with an ft of approximately 500 MHz. In addition to allowing a bias current of 300 mA or more, a high-speed driver circuit is combined to create a ""notchless class A"" amplifier that does not perform switching operation.In addition, the open-loop gain (bare gain) has been reduced and bare frequency characteristics have been improved by one order of magnitude through the use of an element with excellent high-frequency characteristics and a circuit device such as a local NFB.As a result, the bare distortion factor of the power amplifier has been improved to 0.4% (from 2-5% in the conventional model) and the slew rate to 300 v / Ï‰ sec (from 10 v / Ï‰ sec in the conventional model).The equalizer uses a cascode input bootstrap circuit with four FETs at the input stage, combined with a dynamic resistance circuit with transistors to reduce bare strain.In addition, in order to keep the output impedance as low as possible, a SEPP circuit (single ended push-pull circuit) with four transistors is adopted to reduce bare strain.As a result, the bare distortion factor of the preamplifier (equalizer stage) has been improved to 0.2% (previously 2-5%) and the slew rate to 150 V / Ï‰ sec (previously 10 V / Ï‰ sec).At the Duo Beta Circuit, TIM distortion is reduced by applying NFB, which is reduced to less than one hundredth of that of conventional amplifiers, to the amplifier circuit with improved bare characteristics, thereby improving sound quality in the middle and high range.The duo-beta circuit uses a unique DC servo circuit to prevent cross-modulation distortion and SN ratio degradation due to tight low-frequency playback, reduced damping factor caused by reduced NFB, cone excursion of speakers, etc.This DC servo circuit is combined in parallel with a small-volume NFB circuit and uses a low-noise FET amplifier, so a high-quality film capacitor can be used for the filter circuit, enabling tight low-frequency reproduction.In order to give priority to sound quality, the head amplifier for MC uses a DC amplifier configuration in which FETs are connected in parallel instead of connecting many input FETs.N-channel FETs with excellent noise characteristics are connected in parallel, and a constant-current circuit is combined to create a DC amplifier configuration with particularly improved high-frequency characteristics. As a result, there is a slight disadvantage in the SN ratio. However, we have solved this problem by adopting an automatic gain adjustment method that automatically adjusts the amplification factor when the impedance of the connected MC cartridge changes.A buffer amplifier is provided in front of the tone control circuit to prevent the tone control circuit from being affected by other circuits. This eliminates the flat amplifier that causes the sound quality degradation, and the power amplifier circuit covers the insufficient amplification.For the buffer circuit and tone control circuit, a cascode-connected source follower circuit with FET input is used, and for the tone control circuit, LUX system NF type with bending point switching which is easy to change characteristic is adopted.In addition, these circuits can be bypassed when tone control is not required.In the power supply circuit of the power section, high-frequency characteristics have been improved by adopting a high-capacity block and condenser for sound quality and by combining a film condenser in parallel.The constant voltage power supply for the preamplifier section employs a power transistor with a fast switching speed to sufficiently reduce the circuit impedance.In addition, a constant voltage power supply is used for the pre-driver stage of the power amplifier section to stabilize operation.In order to minimize interference between the metal chassis inside the amplifier and the wiring circuit, the chassis corresponding to the printed circuit board is hollowed out.In addition, the cabinet is a wooden box made of real wood, and the shielding of the box is limited to the minimum necessary level, and ultra-thin aluminum foil is used to completely eliminate eddy current distortion."

name: L-68A
description: "Duo Beta plus-X pre-main amplifier that combines a duo beta circuit with a newly developed plus-X power supply.The duo-Beta circuit is used to realize a superior amplifier by taking advantage of the advantages of NFB and preventing TIM distortion due to excess NFB.By adding an appropriate amount of NFB and DC servo to the amplifier circuit that realizes a practical level even with bare characteristics, excellent medium and high frequency and tight low frequency reproduction are realized, and harmful 1/f noise and flicker noise are removed.The power supply section uses a common feedback circuit (which feeds back changes in the output voltage and keeps it constant) and a plus-X power supply that has the advantages of an unstabilized power supply and eliminates its disadvantages.The conventional stabilized power supply consists of a feedback circuit and uses a large amount of feedback, whereas the plus-X regulator uses an appropriate amount of feedback and has frequency characteristics.As a result, it is possible to realize a low-frequency band with good reproducibility and damping by avoiding excessive feedback in the audible band and making use of the bare characteristics of the power supply itself (optimum error-amplifier), and by controlling frequencies to improve stability and controlling force by providing strong feedback only in the low-frequency band.In order to realize a plus-X regulator, we are improving the bare characteristics of the power supply section.The transformer employs a large power transformer that makes full use of Lux's transformer technology. The winding diameter is large to prevent power loss. In addition, an audio block capacitor (15,000 Ï‰ Fx2) is used in the smoothing circuit to create a power circuit with excellent bare characteristics.In addition, the polarity is unified by aligning the winding direction of the power transformer on both the primary and secondary sides, and the polarity of all non-polar capacitors used in the power supply circuit is also unified.All stages use push-pull circuit with excellent linearity for the power stage.In addition to the pure complimentary service differential push-pull input stage using FET with the same characteristics of P channel and N channel, all stages use high-ft (high-cutoff frequencies) and low-Cob (collector-output capacitance) transistors and FET for push-pull. The distortion factor in bare characteristics has been reduced to 1/5 to 1/10 of conventional ones, and the frequency characteristics have been improved by approximately 10 times.The output stage employs a power MOS FET that does not generate switching distortion in principle.Power MOS FETs have characteristics such as no carrier accumulation effect (which contributes to switching distortion) that cannot be avoided in bipolar transistors and no phase shift. They also boast excellent high-frequency characteristics and linearity. They also have excellent characteristics as power amplifying devices, such as high gain, simplified drive stages, and excellent stability.In the L-68A, a large amount of idle current is supplied to the power MOS FET to set the optimum operating condition, and ultra-high-speed transistors are also used in the driver stage to be combined, completing the amplifier circuit that does not generate switching distortion.Duo-beta circuit is also used for the equalizer circuit.The circuit configuration employs a cascode-connected bootstrap differential current mirror input stage with a carefully selected low-noise FET. It is driven with a constant current to improve SVRR (ripple rejection ratio) and has a structure excellent in CMRR (in-phase suppression ratio). In addition, a constant current load cascode amplifier is connected and a shunt circuit is provided to suppress gain.In the output stage, a single-ended push-pull circuit with A-class operation is adopted to obtain high stability as well as low distortion and low output impedance.As a result, the distortion factor in bare characteristics has been reduced to 1/5 to 1/10 of the conventional one, and the frequency characteristics have also been realized with about 10 times the bandwidth. As a finishing touch, the duo-beta circuit realizes excellent sound quality.The MC head amplifier section uses a DC amplifier configuration with N-channel FET parallel connection.In addition, by installing an impedance switch, the optimum load condition of the MC cartridge can be selected and the gain is automatically adjusted.For tone control, LUX system NF type with turn-over frequency switching circuit is adopted with smooth changing characteristics and no waviness.In addition, an independent configuration is adopted in which the front stage of this tone control is used as an FET cascode input buffer. When it is not necessary, it can be completely separated from the signal path by the tone bypass switch.By controlling the polarity of film capacitors one by one and applying bias, even foil vibration is eliminated completely, and clear sound quality without coloring is achieved.In order to minimize the influence of the metal chassis on the circuit, the chassis corresponding to the circuit board is hollowed out, and overcurrent distortion is completely eliminated by using a natural plated rosewood cabinet with minimal aluminum shielding.Equipped with a phono straight function, functions not required for disk playback can be disconnected from the wiring.Equipped with a line-phase sensor, you can check the polarity of the AC power supply."

description: "This is a pre-main amplifier designed to simplify the signal flow by eliminating the need for a phono equalizer and simplifying the internal layout in order to achieve high quality CD playback.By eliminating the speaker selector switch and even the headphone port, it has been completely simplified to achieve pure musical reproduction.The power amplifier consists of a duo-beta circuit with a single-stage amplifier circuit of pure complimentary service directly connected to all stages.By segmenting the return current in the circuit and clarifying the reference point of operation, the transparency of each sound is ensured.In the current amplifier stage, a 3-stage Darlington connection is adopted in order to increase the driving capability at low impedance load.In the final stage, a 150W-class power transistor is used in parallel push-pull, and in the pre-driver stage, a constant-voltage power supply is inserted separately for the left and right sides, for a luxurious configuration.The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer equivalent to 340 VA to realize high drive performance with low impedance.Separate windings are used for the main amplifier circuit, power amplifier pre-driver circuit, pre-amplifier circuit and accessory circuit. name: L-503S
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier with improved cost performance while applying Luxman's technology.CSSC (Complementary Single Stagger Circuit) circuit is adopted for the amplifier section.This circuit is roughly divided into three parts. From the input side, the complimentary service amplifier, the second stage current transmission stage, and the last stage output circuit. The differential amplifier gains the inherent gain of the amplifier circuit. The current transmission stage uses a common-base transistor circuit that is used in high-frequency circuits that require high fT (cutoff frequency) transmission. The output circuit amplifies power.Many general amplifiers have amplification functions in the first and second stages. Since the cut-off frequencies of the first and second stages are approximate values, there is a large phase shift in the ultra-high frequency range as a total characteristic. Therefore, analog information from the output is inverted and returned to the input using NFB. This structure improves electrical characteristics. However, when a large phase shift occurs, the feedback becomes close to positive, and positive feedback oscillation or similar unstable state occurs. In order to avoid this, another local feedback loop is used as a complementary loop. However, this high-frequency correction loop itself greatly affects sound quality and causes a loss of natural feeling of sound.In the CSSC circuit, the cut-off frequency in the high-frequency range is extremely high in the second stage common-base type current transmission stage. Therefore, it can be said that the frequency characteristics of the first stage differential amplifier control almost the entire CSSC. Stable operation can be ensured with minimal correction, and high-through rate is achieved.It is equipped with LUX's unique OD Ï‰ circuit.The OD Ï‰ circuit is the Ï‰ circuit (NFB) of the amplifier, to which LUX added its own ingenuity. In a general amplifier, the NFB is fed separately in the direct current and AC regions. However, by inserting a DC servo amplifier into the feedback loop in order to ensure stability in the DC region, a difference in balance with the AC region was caused. In the OD Ï‰ circuit, excellent DC stability is ensured only by basic DC feedback without incorporating a DC servo amplifier by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit to a high degree. In addition, the NFB in the AC region has been optimized to adjust the energy balance in all bands and achieve a sense of uniformity in tone quality in all frequency bands.The power amplifier has a 3-stage Darlington configuration and uses a complimentary service circuit with low internal impedance, high current, and high fT type power transistors (Pc150W, Ic (max) 15A).In addition, stability is enhanced by using parts such as a large heat sink, high-voltage driver transistors with excellent hfe linearity, and dual transistors for differential amplification.The power supply section is equipped with a large high-efficiency EI core power transformer and a large capacity electrolytic capacitor.It comes with a wireless remote control for power on / off, input selection, volume control, muting on / off, etc.A motor drive volume is used for the volume control, and the input switch is also a motor drive type. This input switch gives a clear click feeling to the step for each position when operating on the amplifier panel. When operating the remote control, the clutch mechanism allows the remote control to rotate smoothly without clicking.The internal layout uses a partition structure to reduce interference noise and distortion by separating circuits such as the preamplifier, power amplifier, input / output terminal, power supply input, and speaker output.The interior uses LUX's own custom parts to improve the sound quality.The speaker terminal is a large terminal that can be attached to a banana plug.The speaker output is equipped with a large, highly reliable speaker relay and an independent headphone relay.We have also achieved low impedance by introducing bus bars.It has phono inputs for MM, four line inputs and one balance input.Two input / output terminals for recording are provided.It includes tone control, loudness and subsonic filter, balance control, recording selector, and mode selector.It is also equipped with a line straighter function, which can provide high quality sound by bypassing unused circuits (tone control, mode selector, left / right balance).An inverted switch is mounted, and the phase of the balance line input can be inverted.Equipped with line phase sensor, polarity can be checked when power plug is inserted.Custom type power cable and AC inlet are adopted.It is equipped with a bus line that links remote control operations of LUXMAN CD players."

name: L-509S
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier with improved cost performance while applying Luxman's technology.CSSC (Complementary Single Stagger Circuit) circuit is adopted for the amplifier section.This circuit is roughly divided into three parts. From the input side, it consists of a the second stage current transmission stage, and the final stage output circuit. The differential amplifier gains the inherent gain of the amplifier circuit. The current transmission stage uses a common-base transistor circuit that is used in high-frequency circuits that require high fT (cutoff frequency) transmission. The final stage is the output circuit. The control amplifier converts impedance, and the power amplifier amplifies power. complimentary serviceMany general amplifiers have amplification functions in the first and second stages. Since the cut-off frequencies of the first and second stages are approximate values, there is a large phase shift in the ultra-high frequency range as a total characteristic. Therefore, analog information from the output is inverted and returned to the input using NFB. This structure improves electrical characteristics. However, when a large phase shift occurs, the feedback becomes close to positive, and positive feedback oscillation or similar unstable state occurs. In order to avoid this, another local feedback loop is used as a complementary loop. However, this high-frequency correction loop itself greatly affects sound quality and causes a loss of natural feeling of sound.In the CSSC circuit, the cut-off frequency in the high-frequency range is extremely high in the second stage common-base type current transmission stage. Therefore, it can be said that the frequency characteristics of the first stage differential amplifier control almost the entire CSSC. Stable operation can be ensured with minimal correction, and high-through rate is achieved.It is equipped with LUX's unique OD Ï‰ circuit.The OD Ï‰ circuit is the Ï‰ circuit (NFB) of the amplifier, to which LUX added its own ingenuity. In a general amplifier, the NFB is fed separately in the direct current and AC regions. However, by inserting a DC servo amplifier into the feedback loop in order to ensure stability in the DC region, a difference in balance with the AC region was caused. In the OD Ï‰ circuit, excellent DC stability is ensured only by basic DC feedback without incorporating a DC servo amplifier by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit to a high degree. In addition, the NFB in the AC region has been optimized to adjust the energy balance in all bands and achieve a sense of uniformity in tone quality in all frequency bands.The power amplifier has a 3-stage Darlington configuration and uses a complimentary service circuit with low internal impedance, high current, and high fT type power transistors (Pc150W, Ic (max) 15A).In addition, stability is improved by using parts such as a large heat sink with a shape that reduces unnecessary noise while maintaining heat radiation characteristics, a high-voltage transistor, and a dual transistor for differential amplification.The power supply section uses a high-efficiency large EI core power transformer and a large-capacity capacitor with excellent instantaneous charge / discharge characteristics.The low impedance design low-impedance design makes it possible to supply music in accordance with the phase of music.The speaker terminal uses a vise screw type made of a unique material so that the cable can be firmly fixed.This connector is also compatible with a banana plug.It comes with a wireless remote control that controls basic functions such as power on / off, input select, volume control, and muting on / off.The volume and input selector are motor-driven, and the input selector is equipped with a clutch mechanism to give a click feeling when manually operated and to improve operability. In addition, the remote control can be operated smoothly.Equipped with bus line terminals, it is possible to link the remote control operation with the LUXMAN CD player.The internal layout is designed to prevent unnecessary vibration and noise. The overall structure is symmetrical to maintain weight balance. Each section is laid out in minimize interference while ensuring extremely high stability. In addition, a box isolation structure with shield plates is employed to completely eliminate high-frequency noise and leakage flux.The aluminum front panel has a special satin finish, which is combined with a lustrous wooden box finish to create a luxurious feel.The front panel is equipped with a power meter.This meter uses a logarithmic compression method and realizes a unique atmosphere by focusing on the color scheme.The internal circuit uses custom-made parts designed for L-509s.It includes tone control, loudness and subsonic filter, balance control, recording selector, and mode selector.It is also equipped with a line straighter function, which can provide high quality sound by bypassing unused circuits (tone control, mode selector, left / right balance).The headphone jack has a dedicated relay contact to eliminate the influence on the speaker jack.An inverted switch is mounted, and the phase of the balance line input can be inverted.Equipped with line phase sensor, polarity can be checked when power plug is inserted.Custom type power cable and AC inlet are adopted.It is equipped with a bus line that links remote control operations of LUXMAN CD players."

name: L-570
description: "This is a pre-main amplifier developed by combining the know-how for ultra-low frequency expression obtained with the M-07 and techniques for processing very small signals obtained with the C-06 and E-06.The power amplifier section uses a pure class A operation method. In this method, a constant bias current is always supplied up to the maximum output, so that there is no fluctuation in the operation point due to the signal, and the high-quality power characteristic of class A operation is achieved.The power supply uses a large-capacity power transformer that is 30% larger than a normal same class amplifier.In addition, the constant voltage power supply section of each stage independent winding has been thoroughly designed to have low impedance to improve instantaneous response capability. In particular, the current capacity to the power stage has a margin of 1.5 times that of the normal one to achieve ultra-low impedance.The signal path from the input terminal to the speaker terminal is structured to completely eliminate complicated routing and unnecessary small objects.For input switching, the wiring is shortened by remotely switching only the selected terminal including the ground terminal at the optimum position near the input terminal. For switching, a nitrogen gas sealed contact relay is used to improve sound quality.In addition, the speaker terminal is dedicated without A/B switching, and the headphone terminal is also eliminated so that it is directly connected to the power stage without any extra circuit.PC-OCC for sound quality control is used at important points for internal wiring.A non-resonant bottom chassis has been adopted for the bottom chassis. Together with the construction with symmetric weight balance on the left and right, we are promoting non-resonance.The amplifier for MC cartridge and the amplifier for MM cartridge are composed independently, and each of them is installed separately.The MC amplifier uses a super-low-noise, high-Gm FET in parallel, and a low-noise reference voltage power supply combining constant current and constant voltage for the power supply part to realize an extremely low-noise power supply with low-impedance output.The equalizer amplifier also operates in class A mode to enable high-quality analog disk playback.The volume part uses an Ultimate attenuator.The conventional continuously variable volume has a limit in sound quality due to the stray current of the sliding part and the material of the contact because metal slides on the carbon film. The Ultimate Attenuator used in the L-570 is a 32-contact rotary switch type attenuator that is based on a newly developed slide rotary switch and consists of a glass-epoxy gold-plated substrate with non-magnetic resistors mounted one by one, and a shield case made of die-cast extruded material. This reduces sound quality degradation in volume.In order to ensure stable operation, we have newly developed and adopted a high efficiency radiator using pure copper fins with high heat radiation effect.The sound quality is further improved by using the same material as the power amplifier M-07 in various parts such as the resistance of the gold plated cap. name: LV-107U
description: "An integrated amplifier that uses a vacuum tube and MOS FET to pursue high-quality music playback.The know-how of the Brid series is further refined as a music player and upgraded in all aspects including the power supply circuit.FET is applied to the first stage differential circuit, 3-pole vacuum tube is applied to the second stage differential section, and MOS FET is applied to the power stage. name: LX38
description: "This tube type stereo integrated amplifier is the fourth generation of 38 series from the first stage SQ38F released in August 1973.The preamp section consists of a flat amplifier circuit that also functions as an equalizer circuit and tone control circuit. Each circuit is fully developed to improve the characteristics.The equalizer circuit employs a two stage P-K Ï‰ NF method (a method in which a blowing sensation is applied from the second stage plate to the first stage cathode) that provides low distortion characteristics and excellent stability over the entire band. In addition, the equalizer circuit is set at an operating point where the current of the output stage is increased to improve the input resistance in the mid - and high-frequency range.The tone control circuit, which also serves as a flat amplifier, adopts the 2-stage P-K Ï‰ NF method to improve the distortion factor characteristics.Low-noise type 12AX7 and 12AU7 are used in the pre-section. Especially, ultra-low-noise type is used carefully for the first stage of the equalizer circuit.For the output tube of the power amplifier section, a 3-pole tube 50CA10 with low internal resistance and excellent bare characteristics is used for AB class operation. In order to bring out the performance of this sphere, a newly designed output transformer is used.This transformer reduces the power loss to less than 1/2 compared with the conventional OY15 type by increasing the diameter of the wire used, and realizes improved frequency characteristics, phase characteristics and AC balance by unifying the secondary winding using the wide optimum load range of the 3-pole output tube.The driver circuit is based on a Mulard type drive circuit (cathode-coupled phase-inversion circuit) that has few time-constant circuits in the low-frequency range and is more stable and can gain more gain. The first stage 6267 uses three connections, and the latter stage of phase-inversion uses a triode 6AQ8 and triode in all stages to improve the distortion factor characteristics in the high-frequency range. In addition, the operating point of this driver circuit is made variable, and it is adjusted one by one to cancel out the distortion in the output stage.The tone control function consists of a 3-point bending point switch for both low and high frequencies. The level adjustment is linked to the left and right channels. The adjustment volume uses a new multi-slider type volume and is equipped with a defeat switch.The CR type filter is used for both high and low frequencies, and can be switched at 2 points each.Other built-in functions include a low boost function, a tape monitor circuit, a tape dubbing function, a Rec out off function to disconnect the recording output terminal, and a -20dB attenuator.The mechanism has been completely reconsidered, and by simplifying the signal path and adopting a printed circuit board, the characteristics and stability are improved.In addition, the speaker switching and impedance switching of the output circuit are eliminated to prevent deterioration of sound quality caused by excessive switch contact passage.The volume and balancer employ a highly accurate multi-slider type volume that can almost ignore the linkage error between the left and right channels.We have also adopted film type coupling capacitors and highly reliable switches.There was a wood cabinet sold separately."

name: SQ-38SIGNATURE
description: "A bulb-type pre-main stereo amplifier commercialized to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the company's founding.It has inherited the title of 38, which is a long-seller for the past 7 models.Williamson circuit is used for the power amplifier section.The inverted signal is formed by PK division with little degradation of sound quality, and the output tube EL34 (6CA7) is operated by push-pull so that the total NFB is kept to a minimum.The output tube EL34 is carefully selected from the special line of Golden Dragon. In addition, 12AU7 is used for the first stage and 12BH7 is used for the driver stage. This is an orthodox element and circuit configuration.For the output transformer, which has a significant impact on sound quality, we have adopted the traditional OY type, which determined the reputation of Lux as a transformer manufacturer.It uses an orient core material and has been newly designed to meet the specifications based on OY's unique split winding. This gives excellent sound quality with little phase rotation and an honest response extended to the low and audible band.In addition, the main body of the transformer is tightly sealed and filled with fixing material. Moreover, it is housed in an iron case to completely eliminate leakage flux.The pre-section is equipped with a custom volume control to improve the distortion and sound quality.The tone control circuit consists of a vacuum tube 12AU7. This circuit allows more natural correction by separating the high and low frequencies.Attention is also paid to basic parts, and consideration is given to sound quality by newly improved composite electrolytic capacitors, high-precision mold resistors, and double-sided glass-epoxy circuit boards.Source Select can switch between line input and tape input / output independently.In addition, if you use a 3-head deck, you can monitor recording simultaneously with the monitor switch.In addition, the line-straight switch allows the source signal to be sent in a purer state by skipping over the monitor switch and balance volume.In order to support CD and DAT, four line inputs are installed.It also has a high-precision phono equalizer.In order to secure the vacuum tube securely and to eliminate the influence of external vibration, the chassis is designed to have an appropriate weight and a rigid structure.In addition, high-density materials are used for the side panels, and materials with different vibration modes are used for vibration control measures.Volume control and selector switch knobs are a combination of blast finish and hairline finish.AC inlet is used for the power cable.In addition, polarity management is also possible by adopting the line phase sensor."

name: DU-10
description: "Universal player compatible with DVD audio and SACD.To maximize the capabilities of both multi-bit DVD audio and DSD SACD, we have installed a PCM D/A conversion route for multi-bit and a DSD DAC for SACD playback. Also, SACD sources recorded in DSD can be converted to multi-bit and played back.Furthermore, in order to realize high-quality reproduction of CDs, detailed studies have been carried out such as re-washing of circuit constants, review of materials, and optimization of casing current.The D/A conversion part is equipped with Luxman's original FE (Full Embassy) DAC.The FE / DAC was installed in the D/A converter DA-07 released in 1989. In the past, it was impossible to install it in an integrated CD player because it was very large. The DU-10 uses a full enclosure interpolation DSP that has been realized by advances in DSP processing capability, and while being compact, it has acquired spatial reproducibility equivalent to that of the DA-07.The difference between the FE-DAC full enclosure method and the conventional Shannon method lies in the interpolation function, and the difference appears in the impulse response waveform. In the full enclosure method, there is no vibration seen in Shannon, and the waveform is clean, reducing the effect on the waveform modulation that occurs at the start of music. In addition, in the frequency characteristic, while Shannon drops sharply at a fixed frequency, full enclosure draws a relatively gentle slope, making it possible to create a space that can reproduce frequencies above 20 kHz in CD playback.The DU-10 is equipped with two types of DACs, a full enclosure type and a Shannon type, and can be switched with a switch on the front panel.The Shannon method is most suitable for electronic music and other genres, and the Full Encie method is most suitable for classical music and other genres, which can naturally express rich a feeling of oppression.For transformer and power supply, the mechanism, video system and audio system are separately arranged, and each circuit is separated by a chassis to increase rigidity and reduce interference between units.In addition, each circuit part is made with an abundance of audio-only parts that have been carefully examined for sound quality to further improve sound quality.The front panel and side panel are made of thick aluminum material, and the upper panel is made of a composite material of aluminum and steel plate to improve damping performance against external vibration.In addition, in order to reduce vibration from the floor, FRP, which has twice the normal specific gravity and is reinforced with glass fiber, is used.Equipped with a decoder for 5.1 ch Dolby Digital (AC-3) and dts surround.The 6-channel circuit is equipped with a common grade audio circuit to ensure high quality.It is equipped with a progressive video circuit and can display twice the amount of information compared to the interlaced method on progressive TV by video interpolation and can obtain images with less flicker.Equipped with a digital input, it can be used as a D/A converter.Wireless remote control is included."

name: D-7
description: "A CD player that inherits the design philosophy of the D-10 and supports HDCD.It is equipped with an HDCD decoder and supports HDCD.In addition, when performing 8 x oversampling interpolation, the dither signal has energy distribution frequency characteristics that do not give a sense of incongruity to the music signal, and the minimum bit is stored. As a result, natural realism is achieved even during normal CD playback.The D/A converter uses PCM1702, which is a 20 bit sign magnitude DAC, to solve 0 cross distortion, which is the largest defect of multi-bit DAC. In addition, the D-7 uses highly selected K-rank high-reliability devices to achieve thorough low distortion.The power supply section employs a newly developed large-capacity custom capacitor with low loss and excellent rapid charge / discharge characteristics. The power supply is composed of a real-time instantaneous power supply, thereby realizing the stability corresponding to the current change of the multi-bit DAC.In addition, by dividing the winding of a sufficiently large power transformer into four systems according to the application and using know-how to prevent current interference such as STAR circuits, interference via the power supply part of each circuit is prevented.The I/V converter with this function uses Luxman's original SSC circuit, and an analog circuit that reacts in real time to the response of the DAC realizes extremely accurate voltage conversion.To prevent interference between digital and analog circuits, the D-7 incorporates an RF amplifier that amplifies the small signal of the laser pickup, and digital signal processing components such as EFM demodulation and error correction into the drive mechanism. The output of these components passes through a shield box and is input to the nearest digital filter. A control microcomputer that controls the entire process is also located immediately adjacent to the digital filter.In this way, the rational layout design that fits the digital circuit in a very small area prevents degradation of the digital signal and ensures a high-purity analog signal.A high-density FRP resin tray with moderate internal loss is used for the disk tray. This tray is mechanically fixed during rotation, overcoming the weak point of the tray which is vulnerable to vibration.In addition, the mechanism is firmly mounted by a solid rigid housing structure with two channels passing through the center of the chassis and both sides of the mechanism in front and back. This structure divides the inside of the housing into three shield compartments to almost completely prevent the functional units contained in each compartment from interfering with each other. In addition, the entire center mechanism is covered to prevent contamination of the laser pickup output signal due to light leakage.The base chassis uses FRP base chassis containing glass fibers with rigidity and moderate internal loss.It uses plenty of high-quality custom parts.Especially for analog circuits such as I/V converters, high-quality parts such as special coated carbon resistors and copper tube shielded Styrofoam capacitors are used.It is equipped with coaxial digital output by pulse transformer with large toroidal core and AES/EBU balance digital output.In addition to the RCA pin terminal, the analog output is also equipped with a balanced XLR terminal.Includes metal body wireless remote control.It also has a display off function, and you can turn off the display by remote control operation according to the brightness and situation of the room."

name: D-10
description: "HDCD-compatible CD player developed with technologies such as Tower DAC.The D/A converter uses the sine magnitude method to solve the 0 cross distortion, which was the biggest drawback of a multi-bit DAC.The structure of the D/A conversion section adopts 4-stage stack tower DAC method.In general, various characteristics such as distortion factor and SN ratio can be improved by driving multiple DACs in parallel. The Tower DACs were developed to take full advantage of the advantages of parallel use. The current balance is maintained in the vicinity of the strictly selected DACs, the boards with the shortest high-frequency bus are stacked on top of each other, and the number of stacks is determined to be four by precise data analysis.This tower DAC structure has the advantage of minimizing the data / clock lines to individual DACs, improving jitter and signal-to-noise ratio by using a shield case, and reducing the influence of mutual interference and straight capacitor by inserting a high-speed buffer into the data line to the tower DAC.The D-10 has a built-in HDCD decoder can play high-quality HDCD discs.HDCD is a CD-compatible disc with the equivalent of 20 bits of information and employs a mapping and dither addition algorithm based on auditory psychological experiments.In addition, the technology that interpolates the lowest bit using a dither signal with energy distribution frequency characteristics that do not give a sense of incongruity to the music signal at the time of 8 times oversampling interpolation provides natural realism even during normal CD playback.High-inertia power supply is used for the power supply part.This power supply circuit employs a newly developed large-capacity custom capacitor with low loss and excellent rapid charge / discharge characteristics. This circuit is able to cope with sudden current changes in DAC where discrete pulse signals and continuous analog signals exist.In addition, a sufficiently large power transformer is adopted, the winding is divided into four systems according to the application, and the interference through the power supply between circuits is suppressed by current interference prevention technology such as STAR circuit.The analog low-pass filter uses a high-purity design passive low-pass filter.The filter with sharp roll-off characteristics is composed of an air-core coil with a shield case developed as a custom part and a copper foil styrene condenser, enabling natural reproduction sound while minimizing group delay characteristics in the audible band.The analog outputs of the SSC circuit make use of Lux's amplifier technology, enabling high slew rate and wide bandwidth. The gain of this SSC circuit is the most suitable amplifier for a high-output CD-player, realizing a high Tyner mix range and high linearity.The power supply section, including the power transformer and rectifier diode, has a box structure, and the power supply circuit is divided into digital and analog circuits to avoid interference from the power supply of each signal system.In order to prevent interference between digital and analog circuits, the D-10 incorporates an RF amplifier for amplifying the small signal of the laser pickup, digital signal processing for EFM demodulation and error correction, etc. in the drive mechanism. The output is passed through a shield box and input to the nearest digital filter. In addition, a control microcomputer for controlling the entire process is placed right next to the digital filter to store the digital circuit in a very small area.The disc tray is made of high-density FRP resin and has a tray locking mechanism during play to eliminate the adverse effect of resonance. The central mechanism section is also covered to prevent contamination of the laser pickup output signal due to light leakage.The base chassis uses FRP base chassis containing glass fibers with rigidity and moderate internal loss.Custom parts developed in-house are used everywhere to further improve the sound quality.The digital outputs include coaxial digital output using a large toroidal pulse transformer, AES/EBU balanced digital output and AT&T/ST link.The analog output has a balanced output in addition to the RCA pin terminal.System remote control is included.This remote control not only controls the CD player, but also controls the basic functions of the Luxman control amplifier and pre-main amplifier via the bus line."

name: D-100
description: "This is a FLUCON size disc player developed as the second generation model of Luxman.A 3-beam system is used for the pickup part.In the 3-beam system, two sub-beams are mounted in addition to the main beam for reading signals, enabling more accurate tracing.A tracking servo is used in the servo circuit, and by reading the tracking error of the main beam by the sub beam, even slight positional deviation can be accurately detected and corrected in real time.As the sensitivity of the servo circuit is increased, it becomes more resistant to vibration and external shocks. However, it may detect even dirt or fine scratches on the disc that are unrelated to the music signal, which may cause malfunction. Therefore, the D-100 sets the servo gain corresponding to the variation from the information storage track, and sets the appropriate servo gain for each condition so that the appropriate servo operates under all conditions.Luxman's original S. T. A. R. circuit is used for all analog signal circuits after the D/A converter.In this method, the ground line and feed line to each circuit block are supplied directly to each point without sharing them, and the shared impedance of each circuit is completely eliminated.In the D-100, the main clock is the clock of the D/A converter. The microcomputer clock and the system clock are synchronized by sending out the clock divided from the main clock. This prevents the beat phenomenon that occurs when multiple clocks are used.The digital and analog power and analog systems prevent deterioration of sound quality due to high-frequency pulse components.It is equipped with functions such as 16-track random memory, search monitor, and all tracks / program repeat.Equipped with timer standby mechanism, alarm clock playback is possible by combining with a separately sold timer.FL tube is used for the display.Equipped with headphone volume.The disk tray uses a touch sensor system, and the sensor operates by simply swinging it to the front of the CD tray without pressing the open / close button, and the tray is stored.Wireless remote control is included."

name: D-105U
description: "A CD player with a 3-pole vacuum tube for output circuit.A vacuum tube is used for the analog output circuit, and it is designed to take advantage of the advantages and disadvantages of each material of transistor, FET, and vacuum tube. In the D-105u, a triode 6CG7 with linear characteristics and extremely low odd order harmonics is used as the cathode follower output circuit, and low impedance output is realized.Equipped with a preheating circuit, the vacuum tube heater can be preheated.As a result, stable operation can be obtained in a short time.A high-rigid lock mechanism has been adopted in pursuit of high-quality sound taking thorough measures against vibration.In this mechanism, the optical pickup base is separated from the assembly base, and a special rubber vibration damper and coil spring are combined between them to eliminate vibration.In addition, the low center of gravity of the center mount realizes a mechanism resistant to external vibration.The digital filter uses an 18-bit 8 x oversampling digital filter.In addition, channel separation and L/R phase characteristics have been improved by making the D/A conversion section independent of left and right.Gold plated terminals are used for both ana-logout and digital out.Two digital output systems are mounted : optical and coaxial.Built-in editing and fade-out functions are useful for recording.It is also equipped with a time fade-out function that allows you to set the fade-out time for up to 99 minutes in units of minutes.Equipped with a display adjustment function, the brightness of the FL display tube can be controlled according to the brightness of the room.It is also possible to erase completely.Wireless remote control is included.The volume part uses an electric volume, and the volume can be adjusted from the remote control."

name: D-500
description: "This CD player inherits the design philosophy and basic configuration of the D-500X's and D-500X' sII, and has been reconsidered with the aim of further perfection.By adopting a top-loading system and eliminating unstable structures such as slide mechanisms, harmful resonance caused by unstable moving parts and effects of turbulence on the disk itself are suppressed.In addition, the entire loading section has a floating structure and is mounted on a solid base to prevent internal and external vibrations and improve tracing capability. In addition, the shape of the recess used to eject the disc is designed to reduce turbulence during rotation.The Philips CDM-3 pickup mechanism is used for the pickup part.In the CDM-3, a die-cast swing arm with a clear fulcrum and a pantograph-structured focus mechanism that keeps the disc in parallel are mounted on the die-cast frame. In addition, the single-beam system, which eliminates the influence of the side-beam, ensures high optical performance. This high-precision pick-up mechanism suppresses excessive load fluctuations in the servo circuit, reducing the influence on the power supply and jitter.The digital filter uses an 8 x oversampling digital filter and the D/A converter is equipped with a high-precision 18-bit DAC. The requantization error and distortion associated with DA conversion are overcome by the pursuit of accuracy, and the configuration is simple enough to cover the basics of the converter. This reduces the burden of complex arithmetic processing and minimizes digital noise.The top panel and bottom plate face each other obliquely, and the body is sandwiched in a wedge shape to form a strong structure. This eliminates natural vibrations and twisting, and ensures excellent stability against external vibrations.In addition, materials with different vibration modes, such as FRP, aluminum, steel plate, and wood, are placed in appropriate positions to minimize resonance and enhance synthesis of the entire structure.By separating the substrate of the servo circuit, which is sensitive to vibration, from the mechanism, the effect of slight vibration is shielded.The power supply section is equipped with a 100 VA class power transformer to achieve excellent regulation.In addition, the DAC / analog section, control section, accessory section, FL display section and FL heater section are each supplied with power from separate windings. By configuring an independent power source in the Line 5, interference between circuits is suppressed and noise is prevented from entering the signal path.The power supply for power supply for the analog section is provided with an electrostatic shield from the winding inside the transformer for thorough cleaning. Moreover, by forming a strong power supply circuit, the instantaneous movement of the mechanism that consumes a large current is prevented from affecting the log signal.A bus bar is used for the power supply circuit, and by suppressing impedance fluctuation when power is supplied to each circuit, a margin for instantaneous current supply is secured.Noise reduction measures are taken by utilizing know-how acquired in amplifier manufacturing such as selection of appropriate circuits and processing of more advanced ground patterns. In addition to eliminating noise sources by adopting shield plates and changing layout, the SN ratio in the sense of hearing is improved by thorough measures against high-frequency noise.High-quality parts are used everywhere to maximize performance from a simple circuit configuration.Custom parts such as pure focus condenser for sound quality, RMA resistance, originally developed electrolytic condenser for sound quality, and copper foil styrene condenser with copper tube are adopted.Analog output is equipped with one fixed output, and digital output is equipped with one coaxial output terminal.The D-500 has a thorough internal polarity control.It is also equipped with a line phase sensor that can control the power polarity (plug insertion direction).Wireless remote control is included."

name: D-500XS
description: "A top-loading CD player.The D-500X's uses a front loading system that eliminates unstable structures such as trays, and the recess for disk ejection is designed to prevent turbulence, thereby eliminating the cause of unnecessary vibration from the root.In addition, the entire loading section has a floating structure and is attached to a strong base to provide a mechanism that is extremely resistant to external vibration. By taking measures against such vibration, tracing performance has been dramatically improved.The Philips CDM-3 mechanism is used as the pickup mechanism.This pickup is a die-cast swing arm with a clear fulcrum. The pantograph shape of the arm has a focus mechanism mounted on the die-cast frame that always traces perpendicular to the disk. The single-beam system eliminates the influence of the side-beam and ensures excellent optical performance.A resistor ladder type DAC is used for the D/A conversion part.The high-precision DAC and 4-times over-sampling enable a low-gradient output waveform, which is processed only by a natural low-order analog filter, making it possible to play music without distortion.The power supply is equipped with a 100 VA class powerful power transformer, and the Line 5 windings of the DAC analog amplifier, decoder, operation, display and accessory sections are separated to provide a completely independent power supply with independent regulators for each section.In particular, the power supply for the analog section is thoroughly cleaned by applying an electrostatic shield to the winding inside the transformer.The chassis is designed to be completely non-resonant and vibration-free.First of all, the overall structure is wedge-shaped to eliminate natural vibration and torsion, ensuring extremely high stability against various external vibration modes. In addition, the main mechanism section has excellent rigidity and vibration resistance, such as reinforced glass fiber reinforced plastic, heavy-weight aluminum top panel, and sidewood, and resonance and vibration are suppressed by using materials with different vibration modes.In addition, the internal structure is designed to achieve high rigidity, non-resonance and non-vibration by combining a double-bottom plate design in which the mechanism part, power supply part and signal system are divided and a thick top panel.The front panel has a simple layout of the minimum necessary keys, which is combined with a multi-functional wireless remote control to improve operability.Each key has its own unique face full touch, providing a light touch but a sharp and reliable switching feeling.FTS is used for the program function. Once a program is stored, it can be recalled as many times as necessary regardless of power ON/OFF. In addition, a total of 137 discs can be stored (one disc can store five songs).The volume uses a mechanical electric volume with an emphasis on sound quality.You can check the volume level with the rotary indicator.The display system uses FL (fluorescent display tube), which generates less noise.In addition, noise control is provided by an independent power supply dedicated to the display and a ferrite core line filter.The output terminal is equipped with one digital output and two fixed / variable analog outputs.We use pure focus capacitors, RMA resistors, newly developed original parts such as electrolytic capacitors for sound quality and copper tube containing Styrofoam capacitors, etc. everywhere, and we use 70-micron copper foil circuit boards with extremely low circuit resistance.In addition, thorough measures against vibration have been taken, such as a copper heat sink, a strong mounting base for power transformers, and a thick copper plate on the DAC.PC-OCC oxygen-free copper wire is used for the part that affects sound.Copper plating is applied to the entire chassis."

name: D-600S
description: "A CD player with an HDCD decoder.Equipped with an HDCD decoder, you can play HDCD.When performing 8 x oversampling interpolation, the dither signal is given an energy distribution frequency characteristic that does not give a sense of incongruity to the music signal, and the lowest bit is interpolated, so that natural realism can be reproduced even during normal CD playback.The D/A converter uses PCM1702, a 20-bit sign magnitude DAC, which eliminates the 0 cross distortion that is a disadvantage of multi-bit DAC.With 8 x oversampling, the folded noise associated with the D/A conversion is distributed over 300 kHz, so the analog filter uses a third order Butterworth filter, which is low order and has little effect on sound quality.In addition, in order to minimize adverse effects on sound quality, the filter element uses high-quality custom parts developed for the Luxman separate amplifier.In the power supply section, the regulator circuit for each supply destination with different characteristics such as analog circuit and digital circuit is subdivided. In particular, the power supply to the analog section is designed to ensure sufficient current capacity.In addition to using a sufficiently large power transformer, the windings are divided into four systems according to the application. By using know-how to prevent current interference such as STAR circuits, mutual interference via the power supply is prevented.The drive mechanism has a built-in digital signal processing section for RF amplifier, EFM demodulation, error correction, etc. which amplifies the small signal of the laser pickup. The output is passed through the shield box and input to the nearest digital filter. The control microcomputer which controls the whole process is also placed right next to the digital filter right next to the digital filter. The j-value circuits are grouped into a small area. This increases the area of the digital circuit and prevents a large amount of noise from being radiated to the surrounding area.A front loading system is adopted for the mechanism part.In order to achieve stable top-loading operation while maintaining the operability of the front-loading system, the D-600s uses a high-density FRP resin tray with low resonance and moderate internal loss, and is mechanically fixed while the disc is rotating.In addition, two channels pass through the center of the chassis to the front and back to stabilize the mechanism by forming a rigid structure that divides the interior of the chassis into three shielded compartments and virtually eliminates interference between the functional units contained in each compartment.The D-600s tray is designed to apply a slight brake just before closing to enable smooth and reliable setting.The transport section, including the tray section, has an isolated structure that blocks the influence of external light, making it possible to read signals with higher precision.Uses custom parts developed independently by LUXMAN.Not only the RCA pin terminal but also the balanced output XLR terminal is mounted on the output terminal.The digital output is equipped with a coaxial RCA pin.It has a headphone port.System remote control is included.This allows you to control the basic functions of the LUXMAN remote control amplifier and pre-main amplifier via the bus line."

name: D-700S
description: "A CD player equipped with an HDCD decoder and developed with the goal of playing CDs at the best quality.This is the first HDCD decoder installed in a Japanese model.In HDCD, recorded information exceeding the frame of the basic format, which cannot be recorded in ordinary CDs, is encoded in an empty area of the track, and this information is analyzed by a decoder and output during playback.The D/A converter is equipped with a sine magnitude 20-bit D/A converter to eliminate 0 cross distortion, which is a problem in multi-bit systems.In order to prevent interference between digital and analog circuits, the D-700s controls the effects of unwanted radiation by placing digital and analog circuits with sufficient space between them and limiting the area in which digital signals are exchanged.We also ensure audio signals of higher purity by designing boards with a rational layout that smoothes the flow of signals through digital filters, DACs, output amplifiers, and other devices.In order to achieve both the operability of the front loading system and the stability of the top loading system, we have adopted a disk tray locking mechanism that automatically locks the tray when the disk is stored inside.In addition, vibration from the outside is avoided by isolating the whole mechanism.The disc tray is designed to provide soft braking just before closing, ensuring that the CD is loaded securely.In addition, the tray section, including the transport section, has an isolated structure that blocks the influence of external light, enabling more accurate signal reading.In addition, high-density FRP material with appropriate internal loss is used for the tray to strengthen the structure, and it is supported by a rigid shaft to ensure sufficient stability and smooth movement.The power supply consists of five windings separated from the secondary side of the transformer and taken out, and the power supply for each circuit is divided by a name: PD272
description: "A player system descended from the PD121/PD131.A direct drive system is adopted as the drive system.A brushless and slotless flat DC servo motor is used for the drive motor. name: PD441
description: "A player system with a floating motor.The PD441 has the same design as the PD444 and is compact in size because it is for one standard tone arm.Quartz lock type direct drive system is adopted for the drive part.By quartz lock system, disturbance load fluctuation of DC range and 1 Hz or less is suppressed, and instantaneous drift and temperature drift are suppressed.In addition, in order to suppress disturbance load fluctuations in the relatively high frequency band of 5 Hz to 10 Hz or more, which is beyond quartz control, it is necessary to utilize the flywheel effect of the turntable. However, bearing life is a problem. To solve this problem, we have adopted LUX's unique load-free spindle system. In this system, the weight of the turntable is canceled by attracting the rotor upward using the magnetic force inside the motor. This reduces the load of the turntable on the bearing to about 1/5.The chassis has a sandwich structure in which a high-density chip board is sandwiched between two 3.2 mm steel plates, realizing a structure with high rigidity and low resonance.Low-fo2-stage damping type insulator is adopted.This insulator is effective for both micro-amplitude vibration, which causes howling, and large-amplitude vibration, which is likely to occur during player operation.The arm base part uses a sliding arm base, allowing easy arm replacement and adjustment of the overhang.The arm base is a combination of a zinc die-cast base and an aluminum extruded material panel. It has a structure that slides on the arm rest rail and is fixed by the lever operation.Equipped with a platter mat, it dumps a turntable by improving adhesion with a record.4 mm thick acrylic board bonded dust cover has been adopted."

name: PD444
description: "This armless player system was developed as a player that can use two tone arms including a long arm in a minimum space.The drive system is a direct drive system that uses a quartz lock system.We have adopted a newly developed LUX's unique load-free spindle system has been adopted to reduce the bearing load on the turntable.The quartz lock system has the effect of suppressing the disturbance load fluctuation of low frequency components of 1 Hz or less from the direct current region. However, the flywheel effect of the turntable is important to suppress the disturbance fluctuation of relatively high frequency components of 5 Hz to 10 Hz or more, which is beyond the control of quartz. However, the bearing life is a problem. In the load-free spindle system, the weight of the turntable is offset by attracting the rotor upward using the magnetic force inside the motor, thus reducing the load of the turntable on the bearing to about 1/5.In the PD444 system, the motor itself has the power to float the turntable, so it is different from the conventional Magne-float system in which the turntable is floated using the repulsive force of the magnet afterwards.The chassis uses a thin, ultra-heavy sandwich chassis.The PD444 uses two 3.2 mm steel plates with a high-density chip board sandwiched between them. The high-density chip board with high internal loss and sufficient resonance absorption is sandwiched between the steel plates which tend to resonate, and it is tightened with screws to realize a chassis with high rigidity and low resonance.The legs are equipped with a 2-stage braking type insulator.The lower fo (lowest resonance frequency) and the higher Q (sharpness of resonance) of an insulator, the better cutoff characteristics can be obtained. However, if Q is simply set too high, the insulator becomes unstable against large amplitude vibration near fo, making it difficult for the player to operate.In order to cope with these conflicting conditions, a two stage damping type insulator was developed. The shaft of the insulator is supported by neoprene rubber to ensure high insulation against micro-width vibration, which causes howling. In addition, for large amplitude vibration, which is likely to occur during player operation or due to the structure of Japanese houses, viscous damping of neoprene rubber coated with silicon grease and structure of spring are used to improve operability.It uses a platter mat that matches the shape of the record, and there are many contact surfaces with the record so that there is no unnecessary space between the record and the mat.The surface uses special synthetic leather that is easy to match with records. Also, the turntable itself uses high-density rubber so that it can be dumped powerfully.The dust cover uses a 2.5 kg total weight dust cover with excellent howling characteristics made of a 4 mm thick acrylic board bonded together.By incorporating a dust cover hinge into the thin chassis body, it fits into a slim player. In addition, a semi-free stop hinge is adopted so that all the weight of the dust cover is applied to the player body when it is closed.The arm base has a sliding structure that can be attached and detached with one touch.It is structured so that it can be fixed by operating the lever at the optimum position according to the overhang gauge written on the panel surface while sliding.For the arm base material, zinc die-cast is adopted in consideration of the howling characteristics, and for the arm panel, aluminum extruded material of 5 mm thickness is adopted in consideration of the beauty of mounting and surface treatment of various tone arms."
